title: specsynth: Cloud-Native Distributed Infrastructure for Survey-Scale Astrophysical Spectral Synthesis (v1.0.0 Reference Catalog)
description: Standard canonical reference benchmark dataset for specsynth: an open-source, cloud-native distributed stellar population synthesis (SPS) framework. Contains 100,000 mock galaxies across a cosmological lightcone distribution (z in [0.05, 3.8]), stellar masses, star formation histories, and double-precision float64 ground-truth photometry across 16 calibrated STScI instrument bandpasses (JWST NIRCam, HST ACS/WFC3, and SDSS) with Planck 2018 FlatLambdaCDM cosmology, distance dimming, and Madau (1995) IGM attenuation.
